title: GeoDiv KAN Solver for Time Fractional Navier Stokes Equations on Complex Domains to Realistic CFD Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.30179v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scientific machine learning provides a promising framework for solving complex problems in science and engineering. Notably, physics informed neural networks (PINNs) have shown considerable potential for solving differential equations and modelling engineering systems. Solving time fractional Navier Stokes equations (TFNSEs) on complex domains is challenging due to temporal nonlocality, nonlinear flow dynamics, geometric complexity, and incompressibility constraints. To address these challenges, we propose a geometry gated, divergence-free Gaussian radial basis function Kolmogorov Arnold network (GeoDiv KAN). The proposed architecture uses geometry dependent feature gating and a streamfunction formulation to preserve incompressibility by construction. translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.30179v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要： 科学机器学习为解决科学与工程中的复杂问题提供了一个有前景的框架。值得注意的是，物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在求解微分方程和建模工程系统方面已展现出巨大潜力。由于时间非局部性、非线性流动动力学、几何复杂性和不可压缩性约束，在复杂域上求解时间分数阶Navier-Stokes方程（TFNSEs）极具挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种几何门控、无散度的高斯径向基函数Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（GeoDiv KAN）。所提出的架构利用依赖于几何的特征门控和流函数表述，从构造上保证了不可压缩性。GeoDiv KAN在方形、圆形和星形域上对时间分数阶不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程进行了评估。数值实验表明，GeoDiv KAN实……
tldr: 本文提出一种几何门控且从构造上保证无散度的高斯径向基函数Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（GeoDiv KAN），用于在方形、圆形和星形等复杂域上求解时间分数阶不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程，实现真实的CFD重构。
en_tdlr: A geometry-gated, divergence-free Gaussian radial basis function Kolmogorov-Arnold network (GeoDiv KAN) is proposed to solve time-fractional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on complex square, circular, and star-shaped domains for realistic CFD reconstruction.
